newsitem.title: USA: Raytheon gets student loan servicing pact.
newsitem.headline: Raytheon gets student loan servicing pact.

text.p: Raytheon Co's E-Systems unit said it has received a "multi-hundred million contract" from the U.S. Department of Education to service the William D. Ford Federal Direct Student Loan program.

The contract includes one base year and six one-year options, Raytheon said. E-Systems will provide program management, software development and maintenance, data center operations and loan servicing functions, Raytheon said.

Under the Direct Loan Program, loan capital is provided directly to student and parent borrowers through participating schools by the Federal government rather than through private lenders, Raytheon said.
